# rustfs_bucket_cors (Resource)

Manage the CORS configuration of an S3 bucket in rustfs

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Name of the bucket

### Optional

- `rule` (Block List) List of CORS rules (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The bucket name

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>

### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `allowed_methods` (Set of String) Specifies which methods (GET, PUT, POST, DELETE, HEAD) are allowed
- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) Specifies which origins are allowed

Optional:

- `allowed_headers` (Set of String) Specifies which headers are allowed
- `expose_headers` (Set of String) Specifies which headers are exposed to the application
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the rule
- `max_age_seconds` (Number) Time in seconds that the browser is allowed to cache the response

## Import

Import is supported using the bucket name:

```
terraform import rustfs_bucket_cors.example my-bucket
```
